name: Mnemosyne

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 提供可检索的本地演化记忆服务
one_liner.en: A local searchable evolving memory service for DSH

local: Node.js >=20 and Python service; adapter starts the bundled service by default.
Stores memory data in a local application data directory; service binds to 127.0.0.1 on a dynamic port.

readme_mismatch: README describes temporal, spatial, emotional and adaptive retrieval as directions or goals; those capabilities are not implemented by the inspected adapter and service code. The implemented search uses SQLite full-text search with a LIKE fallback.

completeness.reason: Adapter and service implement capture, search, mutation, context, feedback and background task flows.

code.reason: Code is split into adapter, client, service, API, models, storage and dispatcher modules with typed Python data models.

docs.reason: README and separate specification, state machine and roadmap documents explain usage and intended architecture.

maintenance.reason: The list reports 34 commits and a recent push on 2026-10-30.

tests.reason: Six test files and CI are present; the repository includes tests for capture, host contract and service resolution.

quality.notes: Code and completeness scores reflect inspected adapter and core service; several remaining service modules were not read.
